question: Chali, Jhumura, and Nadu Bhangi are associated with which Indian classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Chali, Jhumura and Nadu Bhangi** are associated with **Sattriya.**
 
• It is a classical dance form from **Assam.**
